Description:
h2. Overview
Implement JWT-based authentication for the application.

*Key Features:*
- Login with email/password
- Token refresh
- Session management
Custom field (Acceptance Criteria):
- User can log in with valid credentials
- Session persists after page refresh
- Token refreshes automatically

Description: Create React component for login form
Custom field (Acceptance Criteria):
- Form validates input
- Error messages display correctly
- Accessible with keyboard navigation

Description: Navigation menu not displaying on mobile devices
Custom field (Acceptance Criteria):
- Menu displays correctly on mobile
- All links are clickable
- No layout issues

Description: Research and design optimal database schema for user data
Custom field (Acceptance Criteria):
- Schema supports all user attributes
- Performance tested with 10k+ records
- Migration plan documented

Description: Allow users to reset forgotten passwords via email
Custom field (Acceptance Criteria):
- User receives reset email
- Reset link expires after 1 hour
- Password meets complexity requirements
